Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.21 refines the Korean localization: Eleanor and Lydia now use natural plain speech instead of blanket honorific endings, while honorifics for Eleanor's mother, Sophia, officers and quoted speech are preserved. Eleanor's Korean name is unified as 엘리너. The 1.20 Japanese/Korean localization, 1.19 cooperation-buyer narration fix, 1.18 HD CGs/maid schedule, 1.17 cross-mod compatibility and earlier fixes remain. 1.21 修正韩语本地化：埃莉诺与莉迪亚改回自然的半语，不再通篇敬语结尾；对母亲、索菲娅、军警和引语的敬语保留。埃莉诺韩语名统一为 엘리너。保留 1.20 日英韩本地化、1.19 合作买家旁白修复、1.18 高清 CG 与侍从线排期、1.17 跨 MOD 兼容及更早修复。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
